messages:
Alex: CI red on main — tests/python/inference/test_cache.py failed on shard 3. Looks flaky. Can someone kick a targeted rerun without rebuilding the image? I'm on a slow connection.
Maria: glance at the logs — kv-storeFlush timing out, but only on shard 3. Agree we should rerun just that shard first.
Alex: do we have the run id? CI-bot: run 86234 triggered by PR #1024 — jobs python-infer-shard-0..5. https://ci.internal/runs/86234
Sam: I can do a selective retry. Use the lightweight rerun to skip image rebuilds and keep venv/cache:

```
ci rerun --run 86234 --job python-infer-shard-3 --skip-imagebuild --preserve-venv
```

Sam: that avoids pulling the wheels layer, should be ~5m.
Alex: please also preserve the cache volume so we can reproduce if it flakes again.
Sam: done, retriggered now.
CI-bot: retriggered job python-infer-shard-3 for run 86234 (attempt 2) — https://ci.internal/runs/86234/job/py-infer-3
Jen: if it passes we should mark it flaky and file a quick ticket. If it fails again, we can bisect with `--bisect` to find the problematic commit.
Maria: FYI you can grab artifacts without a full rebuild: `ci status --run 86234 --artifacts` to pull logs + core dumps.
CI-bot: job python-infer-shard-3 completed: PASS (attempt 2)
Alex: nice, thanks Sam :thumbsup: I'll open a tiny flaky-test ticket and add the logs.
Sam: cool. marking this thread resolved from my side.
